title: Official alerts
channelBody: Weather warnings and earthquakes published by official services where you are
disclaimer: Nomad Pocket doesn't issue alerts: it shows those published by official services, and they may be late or not arrive. In an emergency, always follow the authorities' alerts on your phone (cell broadcast) and call {{number}}.

offer.title: Official alerts where you are
offer.body: We let you know when a national weather service issues an orange or red warning for your area, or there is a strong earthquake nearby, so you can prepare while you still have a connection.
offer.privacy: Your location never leaves your phone: the app downloads the warnings and checks on the phone whether they affect you.
offer.enabledNoNotifications: On, but notifications aren't allowed: you'll see them in the app.

home.none: No orange or red warnings where you are
home.yellow_one: {{count}} warning in force where you are, none orange or red
home.yellow_other: {{count}} warnings in force where you are, none orange or red
home.noPosition: No location: tap to see the country's

list.empty: No warnings in force where you are
list.emptyBody: Checking {{names}}. Yellow warnings show here; orange and red ones, and strong earthquakes nearby, also reach you as notifications.
list.noPositionBody: Showing the orange and red warnings for the whole country. To see the ones for your area and get notifications, let the app use your location while you use it.
list.noNotificationsBody: You'll see warnings here, but your phone won't alert you.
list.failed: Couldn't reach {{names}}: showing the last data.
list.offline: Offline: showing the last saved data.
list.offBody: Turn them on to see the weather warnings and earthquakes for your area.
list.credits: Data: © AEMET · EUMETNET – MeteoAlarm and its national services (CC BY 4.0) · NOAA/NWS · USGS · EMSC-CSEM · GDACS (EC JRC, UN OCHA).

detail.untranslated: The service doesn't publish it in your language: shown as published.
detail.showMap: Show the area on the map
detail.meteoalarmDelay: Time delays between this website and the www.meteoalarm.org website are possible. For the most up-to-date awareness information as published by the participating National Meteorological and Hydrological Services, please refer to www.meteoalarm.org.
detail.gone: This warning is no longer in force
detail.goneBody: It expired or the service withdrew it.
detail.quakeNote: The earthquake has already happened. There may be aftershocks over the coming hours and days.

settings.enabledBody: Weather warnings from AEMET (Spain), NWS (USA) or GDACS (elsewhere) and earthquakes from USGS and EMSC.
settings.levelBody: Yellow warnings always show in the list.
settings.quakesBody: Magnitude 4.5 or more within 100 km, or 6 or more within 500 km.
settings.positionBody: Kept only on your phone and updated when you open the app. To alert you at once, Nomad Pocket's alerts server only gets the grid square of about 10 km you are in. In the USA it is also sent to the NWS, rounded to about 5 km, to ask for that point's alerts.
settings.backgroundBody: The system decides when to check: hours can pass between checks, especially on iPhone or if you close the app completely. Opening the app always checks.
settings.pushOnBody: Nomad Pocket's alerts server checks the sources every minute and alerts you as soon as a warning is published for your area. It only knows your grid square of about 10 km, your language and your preferences.
